about.second: Born in 1990 in Friuli Venezia Giulia, Italy, he graduated in Economics, Environmental and Cultural Studies in Turin in 2015. He collaborates with a design studio in Milan.

information.first: Since 2016, when Bernava developed the first land art project supported by public and private stakeholders, he is working on a personal research aims not to produce new objects but new ways of seeing what already exists, blending tradition and avant-garde.
information.second:
His practice places observation at the core of artistic creation, by continuously reinterpreting labdscapes through a contemporary perspective. 
He currently lives between Milan and Udine, where he has his studio not far from the city, in the Friulian countryside.
